about_the_game:
DanceXR Discovery is a brand new companion app designed to make finding and installing content for DanceXR easier than ever. Seamlessly integrated with DeviantArt, the app allows users to browse a wide variety of community-created assets and instantly download, extract, and install them into their DanceXR content library with just a single click. This streamlined process removes the hassle of manual downloads and file management, making it simple for users to expand their DanceXR experience with new content.

Available for both Windows and Android, DanceXR Discovery is free to download and use. Whether you’re a new user or a longtime fan, the app provides a convenient way to keep your DanceXR library fresh and exciting. With its user-friendly interface and direct integration with popular content platforms, DanceXR Discovery is the perfect tool for anyone looking to enhance their DanceXR experience with minimal effort.
